stem: An analyst reports Voltmarkt's ASP for TVs as the average of the net unit price on each order line. Why does this differ from ASP as Voltmarkt defines it?

options.text: Every line counts once whatever its quantity, so units are not weighted
Line discounts are left out, so the figure shows the list prices instead
It divides by the number of orders instead of the number of units
It counts returned TVs twice, so it double counts some of the sales
